# eplus

> Fast, light, open-source chat UI with bring-your-own API keys for Ollama, OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral and Groq.

eplus is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/eplus/blob/HEAD/README.md): install, usage and reference
- [How to install?](https://github.com/nirholas/eplus/blob/HEAD/README.md#how-to-install)
- [Single binary:](https://github.com/nirholas/eplus/blob/HEAD/README.md#single-binary)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/eplus/blob/HEAD/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
- [Full text for LLMs](https://github.com/nirholas/eplus/blob/HEAD/llms-full.txt): the README inlined
